tokens.name: lms-paper
tokens.usage: The page ground (brand "Paper"). Body text in lms-ink and lms-muted sits on it.

tokens.name: lms-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, course cards, the footer, empty states, form fields.

tokens.name: lms-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs (Material surface-container).

tokens.name: lms-well
tokens.usage: Insets and tracks: progress track, quiet chips such as "Self-paced", nav hover.

tokens.name: lms-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, surface, raised and well (brand "Ink"; "Bone" in dark).

tokens.name: lms-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads, summaries, metadata, hints, the footer. 4.5:1 on paper, surface, raised and well.

tokens.name: lms-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: lms-outline
tokens.usage: Control borders: outlined fields, chips, outlined buttons, the progress track ring. 3:1 on paper and surface.

tokens.name: lms-secondary
tokens.usage: Forward Teal (Light Teal in dark): the first chevron, the teal tail of the header band, secondary emphasis. Text on paper and surface.

tokens.name: lms-on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lms-secondary.

tokens.name: lms-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Teal-tinted ground: the "By scheduled class" pace chip, teal callouts.

tokens.name: lms-on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on lms-secondary-container.

tokens.name: lms-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: "Enrolled", passed, completed.

tokens.name: lms-success-container
tokens.usage: Success ground for notices.

tokens.name: lms-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons.

tokens.name: lms-warning-container
tokens.usage: Warning ground for notices.

tokens.name: lms-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons (filled with lms-on-danger), field errors.

tokens.name: lms-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on lms-danger.

tokens.name: lms-danger-container
tokens.usage: Error ground for notices and summaries.

tokens.name: lms-on-danger-container
tokens.usage: Text on lms-danger-container.

tokens.name: lms-inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Dark ground of toasts (snack bars) in light theme; light in dark theme.

tokens.name: lms-inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on lms-inverse-surface.

tokens.name: lms-accent
tokens.usage: Forward Clay, the runtime brand colour (Light Clay in dark): filled buttons, links, eyebrows, the header band, the second chevron, progress fill, focus rings. Admins can change it in site settings; the app derives every accent token so contrast holds.

tokens.name: lms-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lms-accent.

tokens.name: lms-accent-container
tokens.usage: Clay-tinted ground: the sign-in hero panel, empty-state badges, text selection.

tokens.name: lms-on-accent-container
tokens.usage: Text on lms-accent-container.

tokens.name: lms-inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Accent for links and actions on lms-inverse-surface (toast actions).

tokens.name: lms-focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings: 3px outline, 2px offset, on every control (Material strong focus indicators use it too).
